When life beans you with a
curveball, you should go to
the beach, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{06 01 00 08 09 0a}

Get a whiff of that, kid!{01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}
Salty sea air is so
invigorating, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 16 00}Maybe I shouldn't drink so
much seawater, though. {01 00 00 05 00}It's
not so refreshing...

{07 0b 00}Ever wanna go to the beach
so badly that you think
your head's gonna 'splode?{02 00 00 0e 0f}
Totally!
Not so much.

{0b 03 00}I like to {04 22 00},
but I was in the mood to go
to the beach today.
Relaxing on the beach will
cure anyone's nasty mood.

{07 15 00}Don't forget that! It's one 
of {04 01 00}'s rules to 
live by, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

Some of my best schemes 
have been hatched while
spacing out at the beach.
{06 00 00 10 11}

{07 00 00}We're nothin' compared to
the wonder of the big blue
sea, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 19 00}Think on that for a while
next time you think you're
all that, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 14 00}Think of the beach as the
set of a big-budget movie.

{07 00 00}You're the star, and
there's a huge spotlight
shining on you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 0b 00}Me?{01 00 00 0f 00} Naw, I'm not
sleepy, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 19 00}I'm just kickin' back and
chilling out on the beach, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 15 00}Man, I hate it when people 
yap on and on using words 
like "calm" and "soothing."
{07 00 00}That's all a bunch of 
hogwash if ya ask me, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}That means you're just a
big baby{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 19 00}Either that, or a grown-up
who has a boring life!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Which is it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 00 00}That's why that 
philosophizing otter is 
always staring out to sea.
He's doing some deep diving
in his brain, thinking...
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 00 00}Man, I have to admire{01 00 00 05 00}
somebody that just doesn't
give a rip, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
You know, somebody who
just lives their life the
way they want to!
